title: Software Engineer, Delivery Platform
teaser: Take on the role of Software Engineer, Delivery Platform, supporting secure and reliable software delivery for Cisco Intersight. Contribute to automation, troubleshooting, and operational support across DevSecOps and CI/build workflows. Ideal for early-career engineers with software development experience and a strong understanding of modern development practices.
description:
Meet the Team 

Cisco Intersight is a cloud-native operations platform that provides unified management, automation, visibility, and lifecycle operations for infrastructure across data center, cloud, and edge environments. Its SaaS, on-premises, and mobile offerings depend on secure, reliable automation that enables engineering teams to build, test, release, and operate software at scale. 

We are looking for an early-career Software Engineer to join Intersight Delivery Platform Engineering. This role will start in CI/build and may contribute across DevSecOps, CI/build, and continuous delivery as team priorities evolve. The work focuses on practical software engineering, automation, troubleshooting, and operational support for the platforms and workflows used by Intersight engineering teams. 

Your Impact 

In this role, you will help build, maintain, and improve automation that supports secure and reliable software delivery for Intersight. You will work with experienced engineers to solve practical problems, improve developer workflows, and grow your technical depth across delivery platform engineering. 

Develop, maintain, and improve scripts, services, tools, and automation used across DevSecOps, CI/build, and continuous delivery workflows. 

Support security automation activities such as vulnerability reporting, dependency visibility, hardened image workflows, scan result tracking, and remediation follow-up. 

Support build, validation, release, and deployment automation by troubleshooting issues, improving reliability, and reducing manual operational work. 

Help investigate pipeline failures, automation defects, build issues, deployment issues, and operational alerts with guidance from senior engineers. 

Contribute to reusable automation that improves consistency, visibility, and efficiency across engineering workflows. 

Participate in code reviews, design discussions, testing, documentation, and runbook updates. 

Work with engineers across DevSecOps, CI, CD, SRE, and development teams to understand requirements, clarify issues, and deliver practical improvements. 

Learn and apply secure engineering, software delivery, observability, and operational support practices. 

Use AI-assisted tools and automation to improve productivity, troubleshooting, documentation, and code quality. 

Minimum Qualifications 

Bachelors + 2 years of relevant experience. 

Software development experience in one or more programming languages such as Python, Java, or Go. 

Basic understanding of modern software development practices, including Git-based workflows, code review, testing, and CI/CD concepts. 

Experience working in Linux environments, including command-line usage, scripting, troubleshooting, or basic system administration. 

Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, learn unfamiliar systems, and work through problems with guidance from senior engineers. 

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document work clearly and collaborate with technical teams. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience with Python automation, REST APIs, command-line tools, or workflow automation. 

Familiarity with CI/CD tools or developer platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub, Artifactory, or similar systems. 

Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, or cloud-native application patterns. 

Familiarity with security concepts such as vulnerabilities, dependency management, secrets handling, access control, secure coding, or supply chain security. 

Familiarity with deployment automation, release workflows, infrastructure automation, or configuration management tools. 

Exposure to monitoring, logging, observability, or dashboarding tools such as Splunk, ElasticSearch, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms. 

Experience applying AI-assisted tools or agent-based workflows to improve engineering productivity, troubleshooting, automation, or documentation. 

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
